hints.title: Tracking Minimal Distances and Path Counts
hints.text: Maintain both the shortest distance dist[u] and the number of ways to reach u in that minimal time.

hints.title: Priority Exploration
hints.text: Explore nodes in order of shortest elapsed travel time from starting intersection 0.

hints.title: Relaxation and Combination Rules
hints.text: If a strictly shorter path is found, update distance and inherit ways[u]. If an equal distance is found, add ways[u] modulo 1,000,000,007.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def countPaths(self, n: int, roads: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for u, v, time in roads:
            adj[u].append((v, time))
            adj[v].append((u, time))
            
        dist = [float("inf")] * n
        ways = [0] * n
        dist[0] = 0
        ways[0] = 1
        
        pq = [(0, 0)]
        while pq:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if d > dist[u]:
                continue
            for v, time in adj[u]:
                nd = d + time
                if nd < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    ways[v] = ways[u]
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, v))
                elif nd == dist[v]:
                    ways[v] = (ways[v] + ways[u]) % MOD
                    
        return ways[n - 1]
```
